assessment_extent.type: full declared-scope independent static primary-source review
assessment_extent.description: Original brief, manifest, all eight required primary sources, and exact hash-verified frozen final assessed. All material final claim groups and consequential governing extraction branches checked; targeted sections and full relevant functions were used, not a whole-repository audit.
limitations: No execution of downloaded source or regression tests; static consequences are labeled inference.
No supplied3.13 or specific<3.12 runtime implementation bytes; documentation-supported transition and backport conditions assessed without certifying those builds.
Author history/read logs, predecessor preservation, and final-only process assertions unavailable. These are disclosed limits rather than assumed verified actions.
No check of unrelated shutil wrapper or other platforms beyond the supplied sources' conditional statements.

D-M12-A.logical_phase_rule: 25min internal sameauthor research/writingreserve; wholejob only30min deadline enforced, no2ndGoal/cancel at25

assessment_extent.source_check_definition: Every consequential assertion, recommendation, condition, alternative, lead and proposed-check statement in all 100 lines of this frozen final was evaluated against original brief and relevant primary passages, including surrounding governing conditions. All six mapped byte bodies were verified and inspected; index identity claims were checked against source content. Full scope here means the declared bounded diagnostic science, not unrelated MQTT chapters or unspecified future technologies.
unverifiable_claims_assessed_as_evidence: Historical failed SQS/CouchDB captures; discarded responses and DNS evidence are not retained.
Original capture-command execution and timestamps; frozen index is self-report, not an authenticated acquisition log.
outside_declared_scope: Unrelated protocol/security chapters and unchosen implementation releases
M14 authored-set semantic/projection/preservation comparison: not applicable to this M12 brief/map; no such views are declared.

defect_identities.title: Unconditional rejection of end-to-end exactly-once protocols
The replay-safe/effectively-once promise omits governing identity and deduplication conditions
Offline capture durability is left outside the allegedly sufficient additions
Outbox atomicity is moved to the wrong boundary and the crash oracle conflates sends with effects
Ordering and replication options lose source conditions and semantic distinctions

assessment_extent.material_claim_scope: Every substantive final paragraph, source fact, inference, recommendation, rejection, uncertainty and proposed oracle; surrounding release/type/default/unit/authority conditions were read where relevant. Not a claim to have read every unrelated sentence of large specifications.
assessment_extent.m14_reason: D-M12-A is a bounded research module. INPUT_MAP declares no M14 authored set, semantic projections or preservation views.
intrinsically_unverifiable_limits: Actual unnamed sandbox storage/ack/conflict implementation and application test outcomes were not provided; candidate properly acknowledges this.

Historical candidate HTTP failures/capture timestamps/source-reading operations are index assertions without full frozen response/operation receipts. Their evidentiary limits are assessed, not upgraded to executed proof.

defect_identities.title: Offline persistence and restart recovery are left implicit
UUID plus a seen-key store omits the atomic effect/key contract
A MQTT session rule becomes a universal reconnect-only retry policy
A failed-state transition does not bound local retained storage
Duplicate inevitability and consumer-dedup exclusivity are overstated
Acknowledgement stages and success/failure semantics are conflated

assessment_extent.label: FULL_DECLARED_SCOPE_STATIC_PRIMARY_SOURCE_REVIEW
assessment_extent.product_claims_checked: Every material finding (final lines 9,11,13,15,17,19), source identity, optional/uncertainty statement and proposed-versus-executed distinction; actual implementation and assertion bodies, not citations/manifest/exits alone.
assessment_extent.chain: Issue -> PR merge SHA -> substantive implementation/filter/caller patch -> actual added regression assertions -> matching selected-release implementation/docs/tests, supplemented by selected-release shutil caller bytes. Later differing code is governed by released source; no invented exact follow-up release mapping.
assessment_extent.runtime_execution: None; neither CPython nor importer test execution required/claimed for this source review.
assessment_extent.predecessor_comparison: Unavailable and deliberately not performed: only frozen exact final authorized.
assessment_extent.prohibited_provenance_check: Historical candidate sourceoperations/no-capture claims cannot be independently verified; content-level distinction assessed, not certified activity.

control.assessment_extent_at_deadline: Primary-source inspections were completed before the deadline, but assessment/report writing was unfinished at expiry. Artifacts were finalized outside both the original deadline and 60-second grace; no reset.
unassessed_remainder_at_deadline: Assessment/report finalization and required delivery were incomplete.

assessment_extent.source_read_extent: All four mapped topic/tutorial documents; full enum capture and complete relevant released read/value/mask/dataset-mask call paths, including branches beyond candidate-selected locator ranges. Entire mapped files hashed and independently byte-compared to official tagged raw URLs. Unrelated write/statistics implementation is not a new subject of this bounded module. Supplemental primary checks cover geometry, external-mask flags and overview conditions.
outside_requested_assessment: Observing an unspecified installed GDAL driver/runtime or actual input raster
Attesting historical candidate operation logs or billing
Unmapped drafts, predecessors, other arms/cases, helper/campaign history and reviews
Checking every unrelated API and every future scientific use of the libraries

assessment_extent.additional_primary_scope: Only targeted release mask-read/shape/default/precedence text, NumPy 1.26 mask API documentation and Rasterio 1.3.10 distribution requirements; no clone or downloaded-code execution.
not_claimed_as_assessed: Actual raster processing or product acceptance on supplied data: no raster inputs or chosen runtime configuration provided.
Historical execution, renderer helper actual code hash, no-manual-edit/no-tests history: independently unverifiable under the allowed scope; receipt consistency assessed instead.
Physical-area implementation or a chosen product tie/coverage/mask/grid policy: intentionally open choices in the original brief.

defect_identities.identity: Raw masked-array inversion omits the all-valid scalar nomask shape condition
Resampling source line range excludes the continuous-data guidance
Mask locators miss valid-zero ambiguity and masked-array inversion
Window read-caveat locator points to a write example

assessment_extent.source_coverage_basis: Relevant complete governing sections across all eight sources checked, including adverse/negative conditions beyond the candidate index. This does not mean every unrelated paragraph of the whole RFC/manpage/book was interpreted.
outside_scope_unknowns: Actual app platform/implementation and target-server/upload protocol capabilities
Historical candidate execution events and capture acquisition times
Runtime behavior, Windows/macOS share modes, server ETag generation policy, browser-specific retention
All irrelevant sections and unrelated source dependencies; an exhaustive universe of mechanisms is not claimed

defect_identities.title: File API snapshot state is promoted to guaranteed old-byte preservation
Local digest, remote validator and upload-resource/version bindings are conflated
Claimed wall-clock retry bound is not supplied by the cited curl mechanism
Validation does not discriminate the transport capability or identity assumptions it claims to decide
Digest-free path/row identity is categorically rejected without distinguishing immutable version binding

assessment_extent.declared_source_scope: Original open-discovery brief/empty manifest, 19 mapped primary capture entries (10 distinct byte sets), all 3 mapped indices, exact frozen final. Four additional bounded primary documentation pages were captured solely to resolve claim-level conditions.
assessment_extent.reading_extent: Contextual primary checking of every subject-relevant claim and its governing conditions, including both RFC renditions and both tus views, with full-text negative searches and relevant section/body reads. This is not a claim to have reviewed unrelated HTTP clauses or every linked document. Hash matches, index labels and search hits were not treated as semantic correctness. Post-write evidence QA rechecked the SQLite failure assumptions, directory flush errors, and supplementary ETag context, then expanded exact multi-range locators where a source fact spans multiple sections.
assessment_extent.m14_reason: This is D-M15-A with no authored-set/semantic/projection/preservation-view task or mapped M14 views.
assessment_extent.not_executed: No runtime fault injection, transfer service, downloaded-code execution, installer, account, purchase, global configuration, repository/canon/WorkNode mutation or third-party write. App behavior, hardware durability and server capability remain deployment questions; proposed validation is assessed rather than fabricated.

defect_identities.title: The local identity gate does not bind checked bytes to transferred bytes
The RFC retry conclusion omits an explicit normative stopping recommendation
fsync-before-rename is insufficient to establish durable publication
The NFS warning is misclassified as an atomicity disclaimer
An explicitly documented descriptor property is left as an uncaptured uncertainty
Terminal abandonment lacks protocol capability and cleanup-confirmation conditions
The proposed checks do not distinguish all mechanisms behind their predicted outcomes
A page-limited missing ETag recipe becomes a false global publication negative
